pages.text: Six strange biomes hide deep underground: magnetic caves, primordial caves full of dinosaurs, toxic caves, a flooded abyss, the Candy Cavity, and the Forlorn Hollows, which you may wish you hadn't found.
Underground cabins hold $(l:realms/alexscaves#cave_tablet)Cave Tablets$(/l) and a $(l:realms/alexscaves#spelunkery_table)Spelunkery Table$(/l) to translate them.
